highlights.text: Suffered an eye injury during a task when hit by Arshifa Khan's hand.
Was teased by Qazi Touqeer regarding her outfit choice.
Joined Arishfa Khan, Mahhi Vij, and Qazi Touqeer in discussing Gullu's gameplay.
Named in the 'Boss Meter' Top 2 finalists alongside Qazi Touqeer.
Praised Gullu after his captaincy victory.
Confronted Aasif Khan over uncomfortable touching inside the house.
Sparks fan speculation after her ex-boyfriend Karan Wahi hinted at entering Bigg Boss 20 as a wildcard contestant following her comments about their breakup.
Had her friendship with Isha Rikhi hit a rough patch.
Avoided eviction following a twist, losing a lifeline after receiving the lowest votes.
Ruled out the possibility of ex-boyfriend Karan Wahi entering as a wildcard contestant.
Subject of news reports detailing her past relationship and marriage plans with TV star Karan Wahi.
Broke down speaking about her ex Karan Wahi, revealing they were planning marriage before a difficult breakup.
Stated that she has moved on from Karan Wahi and wouldn't mind if he entered as a wildcard.
Was declared safe from elimination after the first week eviction was cancelled.
Expressed her dislike for Aasif Khan's jokes to Aman Gandhi.
Opened up about her difficult breakup with ex Karan Wahi and called Gullu a 'red flag'.
Nominated for first-week elimination alongside Kanika, Love, and Arishfa.
Was nominated for eviction in the season's first nomination round.
